claim: One bounded sanitized cohort of ten multi-turn workflow-decision scenarios was run once each, serially, in the foreground against one disclosed Host model. The cohort shows that this model answered each scenario's decision questions in the way the stabilized workflow contracts require.
claim_limits: This is one cohort of ten scenarios on one disclosed model; it does not prove universal Host or provider correctness.
Each scenario received exactly one attempt; a bounded correction after a failure would have required a newly authorized run.
Cost and runtime advisory telemetry were unavailable from this Host and are recorded as unknown, not zero.
Scenarios used no real commit, GitHub write or Enrollment as an effect.
This report does not fix the external H1 Host-producer issue.

runner.model_selection_evidence: `pi --list-models` lists the model under provider `antigravity`; a direct foreground probe returned the expected text with reported provider `antigravity` and model `gemini-3.6-flash`.

authorized_budget.scope: ten serial foreground scenario dispatches, one attempt each

cost.reason: the Host reports no cost for this provider; unavailable is recorded as unknown, never zero

runtime_advisory_metrics.reason: this cohort declared no runtime advisory metrics requirement, so none were measured and none are claimed

source_bindings.note: Bindings are content hashes of the tracked artifacts, not a Git HEAD pointer: the synthetic reviewed revision differs from the execution workspace.
